The '''Royal House of Rydonni''' ruled over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rydonni Prime]]. The [[K'ntarr family]] was part of this house, and included [[King/Legends|King]] [[Rilvvan K'ntarr]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kalieva K'ntarr]].
